mapper.insert: insert into crm_customer (customer_name, gender, phone, photo_url, register_time) values (#{customerName}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{photoUrl}, now())
mapper.select: select id from crm_customer where phone = #{phone} limit 1
select customer_name as customerName, gender, phone, photo_url as photoUrl, date_format(register_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as registerTime from crm_customer where id = #{id} limit 1
